description: Defines a data transfer object (DTO) class 'I18NTranslationSearchFilterParams' for filtering internationalization translation searches in the OrangeHRM system. The class extends a base 'FilterParams' class and includes properties for language ID, source text, translated text, group ID, and a flag for whether to include only translated entries.

classes.name: I18NTranslationSearchFilterParams
classes.description: Data transfer object for filtering translation entries based on language, text, group, and translation status.

methods.name: getLanguageId
methods.description: Returns the language ID used for filtering translations.

methods.name: setLanguageId
methods.description: Sets the language ID for filtering translations.

methods.name: getOnlyTranslated
methods.description: Returns whether to filter only translated entries.

methods.name: setOnlyTranslated
methods.description: Sets whether to filter only translated entries.
